title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-samir-patel
content:
Notes / quick prep for Friday release train sync (weekly). Mostly a scratchpad; will tidy before sending to release@.

Meeting: Release Train Weekly — 2026-03-05 09:00 PT (prep notes)
Owner: Samir Patel (release lead)
Attendees (invite list): release-engineering, release-sre, product-hosted-api, infra, qa, customer-success on-call

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick status (5m): green/yellow/red per area
- Go/No-Go checklist review (15m) — owners call out blockers
- Rollout plan + canary targets (5m)
- Action items + owners (5m)

High-level status snapshot (my read):
- Code freeze: green (branch is cut, PRs must be merged by Thu EOD)
- E2E tests: yellow (some flaky tests in embeddings pipeline; see JIRA-REL-598)
- Infra provisioning: green (capacity reserved, 10% buffer)
- Model artifact pinned: green (v3.4.1-quant6)
- Performance benchmarks: green (p50/p95 within SLO on staging)
- Data migrations: red (schema migration script failing in one shard)
- Docs & release notes: yellow (first draft, needs product review)
- Support/on-call coverage: green (rotations confirmed)

Go / No-Go Decision Criteria (quick checklist, call color/status):
1) Critical blockers cleared (no) -> blocker list below
2) E2E pass rate >= 98% on staging -> current 95% (yellow)
3) DB/data migrations validated in blue environment -> failing on shard 3 (red)
4) Rollback tested and documented -> partial (need runbook update)
5) Observability/alerts in place -> green (dashboards + smoke alerts)
6) Security/compliance signoff -> green (sec reviewed PRs)
7) Customer comms ready -> draft (product to finalize)

Current blockers (to be raised in meeting):
- Migration script for user_features schema fails on shard-3 (owner: Diego Ramos). Repro steps in JIRA-REL-598. Impact: deployment will leave inconsistent schema on shard-3 -> high risk.
- Flaky e2e test: embeddings_inference_timeout (owner: Maya Li). Occurs under specific jitter on staging; scope: may cause false negatives.
- Rollback runbook missing step for KV cache flush after rollback (owner: Samir). Needs explicit sequence to avoid serving stale keys.

Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Hold migration for shard-3 (run a targeted maintenance window and follow manual migration steps) OR delay release by 24-48h.
- Quarantine flaky test from gating for this run with explicit TODO to unblock later (requires triage ticket).
- Add rollback KV flush step and run a tabletop with SRE before release (owner: Samir + SRE).

Owners & action items (clear, with dates):
- Diego Ramos: debug/fix migration script for shard-3 OR prepare validated manual migration doc. Due: 2026-03-04 EOD.
- Maya Li: hotfix for embeddings_inference_timeout flaky test or create skip-with-issue PR. Due: 2026-03-04 EOD.
- Priya Kapoor (product): finalize release notes and customer comms draft. Due: 2026-03-04 12:00 PT.
- Samir Patel: update rollback runbook (add KV cache flush) + schedule 30m tabletop with SRE. Due: 2026-03-04 17:00 PT.
- Diego + Infra: confirm capacity + LB routing for canary (targets: 5% traffic -> 25% after 30m if healthy). Due: 2026-03-04 EOD.
- QA (qa-team channel): run smoke on blue env after migration fix and post logs to thread. Due: 2026-03-05 06:00 PT.

Communication plan:
- If Go: publish short customer-facing note 15min post-deploy with expected change log.
- If Delay: notify customers in scheduled window with reason and ETA (product owns).

Manual run / smoke checklist (quick):
- Verify dark traffic replay to canary nodes -> success
- Validate KV cache warm-up hits (sample keys) -> success
- Run subset of critical user flows: login, prompt-gen, embeddings create -> pass
- Monitor p95 latency and error rate for 30m -> within thresholds

Risks & mitigation matrix (short):
- Data migration fails -> rollback + manual fix (high)
- Cascading timeouts under load -> limit canary traffic and revert (medium)
- Customer-facing regressions in reranking -> hold behind feature flag (low-medium)

Unresolved questions for Friday:
- If migration not fixed by Thu EOD, do we postpone or run manual migration with extended maintenance window? (Triage decision)
- Can we temporarily disable feature X that depends on new schema to reduce blast radius? (Product decision)

Notes to self: tidy this and paste to release channel as prep; call out the 3 blockers explicitly in the meeting invite. Ask PM to confirm customer comms slot.

Meeting prep checklist (my pre-meeting tasks):
- [ ] Confirm Diego + Maya availability + 10m pre-call if needed
- [x] Prepare staging perf numbers (attached gist)
- [ ] Attach JIRA links to agenda
- [x] Draft email template for go/no-go outcome

Follow-ups (post-meeting template):
- Publish meeting notes + decisions in Confluence (owner: Samir)
- Create follow-up tasks in JIRA for any deferred items (owners assigned)
- Schedule post-deploy check-in 1h after canary (SRE + release lead)

Scratchpad / quick references:
- JIRA-REL-598: migration fail logs (stack traces + repro)
- CONFLUENCE-RT-4321: release runbook (draft)
- GH PR: release-runbook/pull/67 -> needs merge for rollback steps

End of prep notes. Will refine into a short agenda email and push to release channel.

- Samir
